Missing: the AI use policy box is still unchecked, and nothing explains how this differs from #39598 (already in maintainer review), #39280, or #39881 (tab handling in code blocks).

```quote
Thanks for the update! Please finish the self-review checklist (including the AI use policy item), and add a short note on how this approach compares to #39598, which is already in review, and to #39881, which also changes tab handling in code blocks.
```
